items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: We used to play on that boat... Buddy accepted that, taking it over to you. We didn't make much money, but I mean, we had so much fun

ctx.x: And, uh, Buddy Van, before, I tell you, when they made us go over the Lakers, we was waking on them, on the steamer camellia. It used to run from, uh, Lellenboyd to Manville. We used to play on that boat, you know, it's a passenger boat going over to bring people like that. And we worked over there, and, uh, one of the guys from over in Covenant wanted, uh, to book the band. So, well, Buddy accepted that, taking it over to you. We didn't make much money, but I mean, we had so much fun, and, you know.
